On Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 09:28 Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'm escalating to runtime and infra now (cc'd Rishi & Aditya). We're treating this as a P1 until we have a mitigation.

Summary of what I'm seeing from the first pass (logs + trace):
- Multiple hosts serving the route show elevated KV cache miss and eviction churn starting 08:48 UTC. KV cache churn correlates with higher token decoding latency.
- A subset of GPUs reported host-side memory fragmentation around the same time; we also see a handful of retry loops where the runtime attempts to re-allocate model state and hits an OOM path that falls back to a retry, amplifying downstream latency.
- No recent model version rollouts in the last 24h, but a kernel patch was promoted at ~06:10 UTC for slab allocation improvements.

Preliminary hypothesis: kernel + allocator interaction exposed an edge-case in our continuous batching/KV cache eviction that causes slab fragmentation on some GPUs under certain sequence-length distributions. That leads to transient OOMs and retries which blow up p99.

Immediate mitigations we can execute in parallel (low risk -> higher risk):
1) Route Finlytics traffic to a smaller-ram model variant (redwood-open-1-3b) for the next 30m as a temporary failover (expected ~10–15% quality delta).
2) Enable a conservative KV cache eviction policy for the route (reduces churn; small latency improvement).
3) Hotpatch allocator knobs to force faster compaction on affected hosts (requires short-serving windows; higher risk).
4) If needed, pin their traffic to dedicated capacity until we resolve (commercial & ops impact).

I attached the morning-incident-checklist.md we use for these cases. Action items for this message:
- Monica: confirm whether Finlytics accepts temporary model downgrade or wants to be pinned to Dedicated.
- Aditya: check node recycle logs and confirm which host IDs hit the alloc OOM path.
- Evelyn: advise on potential credit / SLA concession if we need to propose pinning or extended downtime.

I'll keep the bridge updated.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
